independence: Reviewer created earlier Demon RUN candidates but did not create these boss-fix08 sources; this is separate review of the new selected E sources.
method: Actual private view_image vision of all three complete source PNGs (eight authored poses) and the specified six-pose selection. Geometry/check pins read only. No new generation, source edits, Git changes or image forwarding.

reference.basis: Exact current project crop: red muscular two-horned biped, spiked dark plate, skullbelt/chains, attached tail, RIGHT axe and LEFT empty hand, no wings.

observations.observation: The large near anatomical RIGHT lower leg extends forward/down and its foot/claws flatten at the low plant line. The smaller far LEFT leg folds behind with its foot clearly lifted.

The large near anatomical RIGHT thigh/knee is lifted high near waist level with near foot/claws tucked visibly above ground. The smaller far anatomical LEFT lower leg extends down/back to the low plant foot. This is an actual opposite-support pose, rather than reusing phase0 near-right support.

findings.comparison_to_prior: The earlier E-v02 six poses repeated near-leg support at0/3. The new pair actually changes which anatomical leg is low and supporting, while the axe hand stays fixed; the old same-foot defect is visibly improved.

findings.observation: RIGHT-half rows1/2 keep near-right leg low/pushing back while far-left knee moves up/forward. LEFT-half rows1/2 keep near-right knee/foot high while far-left leg is low then extends back. Their selected sequence preserves the different support halves established by pair0/3. LEFT-half row0 instead repeats near-right plant and is correctly excluded. Static poses do not certify exact lift-off timing.

All selected figures point head, snout and legs to SCREEN RIGHT. One side of the face dominates; near shoulder/arm largely occludes the far shoulder; torso and belt ornament are foreshortened from the side. This is substantially more lateral/E than the prior broad front-chest SE-like E candidate. No S/front or NE/back camera substitution was observed among these selected E poses. Fine camera calibration beyond this first source screen is not asserted.

The same near anatomical RIGHT arm/wrist visibly grips the axe shaft in the landing pair and both half-cycle sheets; the source is not mirrored to swap support. LEFT claw is empty where visible; its distal part is partly occluded by the raised leg/torso in some high-knee poses, with no extra weapon observed.

Muscular red body, black swept horns, heavy spiked dark pauldron/bracer/greave, skullbelt/chains, attached tail and large iron axe remain present. Exactly two legs are readable with different near/far scale, and no wings or replacement lava-fist anatomy are introduced.

Full horns, axe blade, hands where exposed and both feet are present in the selected source images. No visible frame-edge truncation or severe limb/body collapse was observed. Source geometry checks are owned by the producer and pinned separately, not used alone as visual approval.

unseen_not_reviewed: Exact timed loop cadence, transitions and continuity after native assembly
Actual moving-world contact and ground collision
Runtime target contact and default Main scene
Other directions/roles of the full boss candidate
scope_note: Unseen items are deferred scope, not newly imposed first-pass gates. The positive decision here is limited to the visibly improved E direction, stable axe identity and explicit opposite support in selected source poses.
